is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus mosquitoes (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Ace-1 N485I, Vgsc L1014F/S, and Cyp6p9a (page 1, Abstract; page 4, Methods).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports that all samples tested for Ace-1 N485I (N=144), Cyp6p9a (N=30), and Vgsc L1014F/S (N=20) were wild type (page 1, Abstract; page 6, Results).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from Lare district, Gambella Regional State, Ethiopia (page 1, Abstract; page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical research study involving field collection and molecular analysis of mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the collection location as Lare district, Gambella Regional State, Ethiopia (page 2, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The collection period is stated as June 2018 to July 2020 (page 1, Abstract; page 3, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new longitudinal collection of mosquitoes from Lare district.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data regarding sample sizes and results are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the species composition, Plasmodium infection rate, and insecticide resistance markers (Ace-1 N485I, Vgsc L1014F/S, and Cyp6p9a) in Anopheles funestus collected from Lare district, Ethiopia, between 2018 and 2020. All samples were identified as An. funestus s.s. and were found to be wild-type for the tested resistance markers.
